focus.action: After an enemy inhibitor falls, all five group for one push at the enemy Core, and when Drongo razes an allied lane, Gadget and Skylar defend before the team starts the next Fangtooth.

6.5.call: Four kills without a loss, Riktor's on the offlane, Skylar's in the enemy jungle and two on the duo lane, yet Kaelen still took Fangtooth in the window. Once Kaelen starts the pit, the nearest three contest the pit.

23.7.call: At the Fangtooth pit Skylar killed Aurora and Kaelen, but Muriel, Skylar and Khaimera died there, and Legion then razed the allied duo inner. After losing three at a pit, send one player to the duo inner.

26.8.call: Best stretch of the game: five kills to two across three lanes, then Riktor razed the enemy offlane inner and Khaimera took Orb Prime. Chain the next push straight into an inhibitor.

32.7.call: With Muriel and Riktor already dead, Legion and Kaelen killed Khaimera and Gadget at the Fangtooth pit after the enemy took Primal Fangtooth. Two down means conceding the pit and defending mid.

threats: Heal-stacking: Aurora. Anti-heal is mandatory against this comp — we brought 1 item of it.
Enemy is 4/5 physical — a single armor item blunts most of their damage; itemize armor on anyone diveable.
synergy: Our engage/CC: Riktor Riplash (pull), Riktor Shock Therapy (silence 0.8s), Riktor Skewer (suppress 1.25s), Gadget Security Gate (root 1s). Our kills come from landing burst INSIDE that CC window — whoever lands it, the rest must follow up immediately.
We have sustain (Riktor, Muriel) — favor the longer fight where our heals out-grind them.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Riplash to pull a hero in, Shock Therapy to break their shield and silence, Electrocute aura for damage and a shield, then Skewer to suppress everyone in front of him.
ourKits.winCondition: Land Riplash and chain silence and suppress so the target cannot fight back while their cooldowns stay frozen.
ourKits.passive: Suspended Sentence: while his abilities immobilize or silence a hero, their cooldowns stop ticking.
ourKits.playWith: Burst that deletes his pulled or suppressed target.
ourKits.playAgainst: Stay behind minions or spaced so Riplash cannot reach you, and fight while it is on cooldown. Tenacity shortens the chain, which also shortens the cooldown freeze.

ourKits.combo: Ambush leap and slow, Unleash for maximum attack speed cleaving basics, Cull to lock the target, Invigorate to cleanse and heal.
ourKits.winCondition: Stick to one target, build Rage for regen and faster cooldowns, and out-sustain them in long fights.
ourKits.passive: Ancestral Fury builds Rage on hits, giving health regen and faster cooldowns, plus movement speed at high Rage.
ourKits.playAgainst: Buy anti-heal to cut Invigorate and Rage regen. Save your CC until after Invigorate is used since it cleanses, and break off for a few seconds so his Rage decays.

ourKits.combo: Security Gate roots, Sticky Mine is empowered by a basic attack, Seek and Destroy follows the target, then Tesla Dome traps the fight
ourKits.winCondition: root with the gate and hold enemies inside the Tesla Dome while it shreds magical armor
ourKits.passive: FDA stacks from kills, ability hits and takedowns permanently grant magical power
ourKits.playWith: frontline that holds enemies inside the Dome
ourKits.playAgainst: do not walk through Security Gate; leave Tesla Dome early since it grows larger; with no mobility in the kit, dive Gadget after the gate is used; magic armor helps

ourKits.combo: Plasma Grenade slow → Air Assault to hover with extra range → Hypercharge burst → Atomiser to finish a low target
ourKits.winCondition: hover with Air Assault for extra basic range and shred with Hypercharge, refreshing it on takedowns
ourKits.passive: extra jump height; kills make the target explode, much larger from enemy heroes
ourKits.playWith: a frontline that holds enemies in place while she hovers and fires
ourKits.playAgainst: Air Assault is her only reposition, so engage after it ends and she is back on the ground; dodge Plasma Grenade's slow and sidestep the Atomiser channel, which stops on the first hero hit

ourKits.combo: Throw Alacrity for a shield and speed, place Consecrated Ground for ally attack speed and healing, fully charge Serenity for a stun, and use Reversal of Fortune to fly to an ally anywhere and knock up enemies on arrival.
ourKits.winCondition: Keep the carry alive with shields and Reversal of Fortune saves while Sentinel cuts enemy healing.
ourKits.passive: Sentinel: her damaging abilities cut enemy healing and her abilities boost allies' healing and shielding received.
ourKits.playWith: A hyper-carry she can shield and a team that can follow her global ult into a fight.
ourKits.playAgainst: Watch for the charging Serenity bolt and step out of its line before it reaches max charge. When Reversal of Fortune is down she cannot join distant fights, so pick off her side lanes then.

enemyKits.combo: Root a target with Static Trap, shred armor with Buckshot, stack attack speed with Hot Pursuit and finish with the long-range Charged shot or Long Arm of the Law.
enemyKits.winCondition: Control space with traps and out-range enemies with Charged basic attacks, then snipe low targets anywhere with Long Arm of the Law.
enemyKits.passive: Shots Fired: after 5 landed basic attacks his next one gains extra range and bonus damage.
enemyKits.playWith: A frontline or peeling support, since his only escape tools are Buckshot's push back and Hot Pursuit's speed.
enemyKits.playAgainst: Avoid fighting over Static Traps and engage after Buckshot is used, since it is his push-back peel. Stay out of the ult line at low health; armor does not help against Long Arm of the Law.

enemyKits.combo: Old Rusty slows on the way out and back, Gag Grenade silences, Rad Rounds stacks Irradiate on basics, then Shrapnel Cannon shreds armor and erupts Irradiate
enemyKits.winCondition: kite from range, stack Wastelander bleed and Rad Rounds, and use Shrapnel Cannon to shred or escape
enemyKits.passive: critical strikes and ability hits apply a max-health bleed
enemyKits.playWith: peel and frontline so he can free-fire
enemyKits.playAgainst: dodge Gag Grenade's silence; Shrapnel Cannon cast in the air launches him away and is briefly unstoppable, so engage after it is used; armor blunts his physical damage

enemyKits.combo: Glacial Charge dashes in, Boreal Sweep slows, Hoarfrost roots enemies that touch the ring, then Cryoseism slows and stuns a target before it explodes
enemyKits.winCondition: chain slow, root and stun to lock fights down while her Frost Storm grinds max-health damage
enemyKits.passive: jumping mid-air leaps her and leaves a Replica that draws tower aggro; hitting a Hero or Monster 4 times summons a Frost Storm
enemyKits.playWith: burst damage that turns her long CC chain into kills
enemyKits.playAgainst: do not walk into the Hoarfrost ring while it persists; Cryoseism slows before it stuns, so cleanse or tenacity help, and spread so the explosion does not chain; she is weak once Glacial Charge is down

enemyKits.combo: Saturation Charge mines to slow, Frag Order to launch enemies, Orbital Sanction to track them, Rally Point to knock back divers and heal allies.
enemyKits.winCondition: Hold an area with Orbital Sanction and mines while Rally Point keeps his team healthy and his rifle on infinite ammo.
enemyKits.passive: Ballistic Calibration turns bonus attack speed into ability haste and unlocks ability upgrades at item stat thresholds.
enemyKits.playWith: Frontliners who fight inside Rally Point's heal and hold enemies in the Orbital beam.
enemyKits.playAgainst: Stun him while he cooks Frag Order to make him drop it. Bait Rally Point's knockback before engaging, trade when he reloads, and buy anti-heal against Rally Point's heal and armor against his physical damage.

enemyKits.combo: Rimefang to stun, slow and lay Rimeglass, Winter's Pursuit onto the Frostbitten target to root them, Razorstorm on Rimeglass, then Frostfall to crash down and root the center.
enemyKits.winCondition: Fight on his Rimeglass, where Razorstorm boosts his armor and Frostbite deals max health true damage and sets up Winter's Pursuit roots.
enemyKits.passive: Heart of Ice makes his abilities leave Rimeglass that slows and burns enemies with Frostbite.
enemyKits.playWith: Damage dealers who can follow up on his roots and Frostfall.
enemyKits.playAgainst: Step off Rimeglass so Frostbite ends before Winter's Pursuit can root you. Frostfall channels before he leaps, so move out of the center of the landing and leave the Rimestorm; tenacity helps against the roots.

They brought 11 hard-CC abilities to our 7. Fight after Kaelen's Frostfall and Murdock's Static Trap and Drongo's Gag Grenade are used, spread out instead of grouping in a line, and the front line can buy tenacity.

Theirs: Murdock Buckshot, Murdock Static Trap, Drongo Gag Grenade, Drongo Shrapnel Cannon, Aurora Hoarfrost, Aurora Cryoseism, Legion Frag Order, Legion Rally Point, Kaelen Rimefang, Kaelen Winter's Pursuit, Kaelen Frostfall.

bullets: Tainted Blade cut the healing of anyone Kaelen hit with physical damage, and Razorstorm's cuts every 0.25s kept that healing cut up through the spin.
Krix raised Kaelen's maximum health, Cannibalism added more maximum health with each takedown, and Regenerative Tissue regenerated health after a stretch without taking hero damage.
Basilisk and Tainted Blade haste brought Frostfall back 23% sooner, and enemies inside the Rimestorm left behind stayed under Frostbite: slowed and taking maximum-health true damage.
Basic attacks set off Sky Splitter's current-health damage, and on a short cooldown Scattershot's 2 extra projectiles, carrying on-hit effects at 50% to the closest enemies.
Imperator made critical strikes hit harder, Nuclear Rounds turned critical strike chance into more ability damage, and each critical strike also applied the Wastelander bleed.
Weald fired true-damage projectiles at heroes under 30% health, once per cooldown each; Dryad's Boon cut basic ability cooldowns on hit; Wind-Rider added attack speed after dashes.
Nihil's Doom built power and armor the longer Riktor kept hitting heroes; From the Abyss healed during hero combat; Adaptive Plating added armor of the damage type taken.
Electrocute's aura pulsed extra damage when Riktor was hit, capped in rate; Forticus shielded on hero damage, then cooled down; Fist Of Razuul built toward empowered attacks.
Skewer came back 37% sooner from 58 ability haste, Shock Therapy's silence paused enemy cooldowns, and Flux Matrix made nearby enemy heroes take more magical damage.
Off cooldown, Idrisil added armor above 30% health, becoming an armor-scaled shield on dropping below; Mending restored missing health after hero damage; Glacier grew magical armor from gold.
Invigorate cleansed debuffs and healed from maximum health and current health regeneration; Rage from Ambush and basic attacks made every cooldown, Invigorate included, progress faster.
Unleash gave rapid basic attacks, each spreading Overlord damage around the target, while Fire Blossom burned nearby enemies and Forticus shielded Khaimera on hero damage, then cooled down.
Ability hits set off Combustion's area blast, then a cooldown that hero hits shorten; Wraith Leggings added magical ability damage on heroes below 40% health.
Vesh added lingering damage to ability hits on heroes, Mind Rot added current-health damage, and Tithe of Death takedowns restored mana and stacked capped permanent ability haste.
A basic attack on a hero carrying a Sticky Mine empowered the explosion, and Soulbinder added 8% damage to ability hits on heroes from 1450+ range.
